name: Certificate IV in Building and Construction
short_description: Develop the practical knowledge and technical skills required to work in the building and construction industry. This qualification introduces construction planning, site supervision, building codes, safety requirements and project administration.
hero_description: Develop the practical knowledge and technical skills required to work in the building and construction industry. This qualification introduces construction planning, site supervision, building codes, safety requirements and project administration.
overview: Develop the practical knowledge and technical skills required to work in the building and construction industry. This qualification introduces construction planning, site supervision, building codes, safety requirements and project administration.
important_information: Training combines classroom learning, practical activities and online learning resources.
Students develop skills through realistic construction scenarios and supervised practical tasks.

learning_outcomes.title: Structural Principles
learning_outcomes.description: Apply NCC structural principles, footing design, and framing tolerances to residential and low-rise buildings.

learning_outcomes.title: Plans & Specifications
learning_outcomes.description: Read, interpret, and cross-reference architectural working drawings, engineering notes, and NCC codes.

learning_outcomes.title: Site Operations & Subcontractors
learning_outcomes.description: Plan, schedule, and supervise trade contractors, deliveries, and critical path milestones.

learning_outcomes.title: WHS & Risk Systems
learning_outcomes.description: Implement active site safety systems, hazardous material handling, and Safe Work Method Statements (SWMS).

learning_outcomes.title: Estimating & Contracts
learning_outcomes.description: Prepare competitive project tenders, material schedules, client building contracts, and variation agreements.

learning_outcomes.title: Compliance & Quality Audit
learning_outcomes.description: Execute staged structural inspections, defect rectification records, and handover sign-offs.

entry_requirements.introduction: Our admission officers review each applicant holistically, balancing formal trade background with real site-based experience.

requirements.label: Age requirement
requirements.value: Applicants should be at least 18 years of age.

requirements.label: English language
requirements.value: Applicants should have sufficient English language skills to participate in training and assessment.

requirements.label: Academic requirement
requirements.value: Completion of Year 10 or an equivalent level of education is recommended.

limitations: Licensing requirements vary by state and territory. Completing this qualification does not automatically guarantee a building licence.
Students should confirm current licensing requirements with the relevant state or territory authority.

units.name: Apply building codes and standards to the construction process for Class 1 and 10 buildings
Manage work health and safety in the building and construction workplace
Select, prepare and administer a construction contract
Identify and produce estimated costs for building and construction projects
Produce labour and material schedules for ordering
Select, procure and store construction materials for building and construction projects
Supervise site communication and administration processes
Apply structural principles to the construction of buildings

licensing_regulatory_information.description: This qualification may support pathways towards relevant building and construction roles. Licensing and registration requirements depend on the work performed and the state or territory in which you intend to work. Always check the current requirements with the relevant authority.

rpl_credit_transfer.description: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) may be available for applicants who can demonstrate relevant existing skills, knowledge and work experience. Credit transfer may also be considered for equivalent completed units.
rpl_credit_transfer.recognition_statement: All RPL and credit transfer applications are assessed in accordance with the college policies and applicable training requirements.

rpl_steps.title: Free Skills Audit
rpl_steps.description: Complete our 2-minute pre-assessment to verify if your existing experience aligns with the required units.

rpl_steps.title: Evidence Review
rpl_steps.description: Upload site photos, trade licenses, payslips, supervisor third-party references, and plans managed.

rpl_steps.title: Certification
rpl_steps.description: Participate in a practical competency conversation with our licensed assessor and receive your parchment.

image_section.title: Led by Registered Building Practitioners
image_section.description: Assessed under Victorian VBA & NSW Fair Trading licensing benchmarks

recommendations: Licensed Trade (3+ yrs on site) → RPL

career_pathways.title: Domestic Builder (DB-U)
career_pathways.description: Register to legally quote, manage, and construct residential developments valued over $10,000.

career_pathways.title: Site Supervisor
career_pathways.description: Oversee daily on-site trades, enforce QA checklists, and ensure structural compliance with engineering.

career_pathways.title: Construction Estimator
career_pathways.description: Quantify architectural scopes of work, formulate trade tenders, and administer project cost margins.

career_pathways.title: Project Coordinator
career_pathways.description: Manage council permits, surveyor staging approvals, and project variation timelines.

industry_outcomes.introduction: Holding AUR30620 is the premier recognized qualification benchmark prescribed by Australian regulatory bodies (such as VBA, NSW Fair Trading, QBCC) when applying for building practitioner registration.
